summary: Artheon is the 2026 rebrand of CME Associates, a Trilon Group-backed engineering, surveying and construction-management firm of 720+ professionals serving New Jersey and New York public agencies, municipalities and private developers, headquartered at 1 Tower Center Blvd in East Brunswick. Its front door is weak: the contact page publishes only seven city names with phone numbers, no form, no email and no street addresses, and no page on the site actually links to it. The firm is meanwhile hiring heavily (94 open roles, including six Office Engineer and three Proposal Coordinator posts), which points to a large, document- and coordination-heavy back office.

facts.fact: Artheon was formed by integrating CME, Churchill, Naik and Laberge, has more than 720 professionals, and serves public agencies, municipalities, private developers and institutional clients across the full infrastructure lifecycle.

Artheon describes itself as a platform company of Trilon Group; the published timeline runs Laberge 1964, Churchill 1976, CME 1983, Naik 1997, Trilon acquisition of CME 2022, CME purchases Churchill 2024, all four combined as Artheon 2026.

Contact page lists seven offices as city plus phone only (Neptune 732.462.7400, Camden 732.410.2651, East Brunswick 732.727.8000, Barnegat 732.410.2650, NYC 646.604.5628, Cape May Court House 609.465.3333, Berlin 856.767.6901), with no form, no email address, no street addresses and no hours.
The site's navigation and footer contain no link to the contact page at all: no anchor on the home page points to /contact/, and the only prominent header call to action is Careers.
Old CME URLs no longer resolve to matching pages: https://cmeusa1.com/contact/ lands on the Artheon home page, not the Artheon contact page (verified in browser).

Google Business Profile is still named CME Associates, category Engineering consultant, rating 3.9, address 1 Tower Center Blvd, East Brunswick, NJ 08816, phone (732) 727-8000, hours shown as Closed - Opens 9 AM Mon, website field still cmeusa1.com.
East Brunswick Township awarded its 2026 Township Engineer contract to CME Associates, not to exceed $200.00 per hour, by Resolution 26-09 adopted January 12, 2026.

Borough of Edgewater Resolution 2026-150 (May 18, 2026) records that CME Associates, 3141 Bordentown Avenue, Parlin NJ, notified the borough on April 20, 2026 that it had merged with Naik Consulting Group and Churchill Consulting Engineers into Artheon Incorporated, 1 Tower Center Boulevard, 20th Floor, East Brunswick NJ 08816, and approves assignment of the engineer contract with a tentative assignment date of May 1, 2026.

The Trilon-hosted Artheon job board showed 94 open jobs, including six Office Engineer, seven Resident Engineer, six Construction Inspector - Transportation, three Proposal Coordinator and two Estimator postings spread across East Brunswick, Neptune, Camden, Barnegat, Berlin, Cape May Courthouse, New York and Albany.

The Office Engineer posting lists duties that are almost entirely record and document tracking: maintaining project records, correspondence and logs, reviewing and tracking RFIs, submittals and shop drawings, preparing daily/weekly/monthly reports, tracking approvals and meeting minutes, with Excel/Word/Outlook and preference for Bluebeam, Primavera P6 and Procore.

The Proposal Coordinator posting covers reviewing RFQs/RFPs and bid documents for submission requirements, building proposal schedules, compliance matrices and checklists, formatting resumes and project profiles, and maintaining pursuit logs.
Leadership page lists Andy Paluri, PE, PTOE as Chief Executive Officer, plus Laura Neumann, PE, PP as Vice President, Central Jersey.

The site runs on WordPress with a cookie-consent banner, publishes only WebPage/Organization structured data on the contact page (no LocalBusiness, address, hours or telephone), and credits the build to web design agency Splendor in the footer.

operations_signals: Inbound business is phone-only: the contact page publishes seven office numbers and nothing else, so a prospective client must choose a city and dial rather than describe a project (https://artheon.com/contact/).
The contact page is orphaned - no header, footer or body link on the home page points to /contact/, and the main header CTA is Careers (https://artheon.com/).

Every legacy CME URL collapses to the home page: cmeusa1.com/contact/ redirects to artheon.com rather than to the new contact page, so links in old proposals, emails and municipal records dead-end (https://cmeusa1.com/contact/).

No published service hours on the site; hours exist only in the Google profile, shown as Closed - Opens 9 AM Mon, with no after-hours or emergency channel described anywhere (https://www.google.com/maps/search/CME+Associates+1+Tower+Center+Blvd+East+Brunswick+NJ).

Office-level routing is manual by design: a caller picks one of seven city numbers with no published service-to-office mapping, and the new brand has not yet been adopted on the Google listing that still says CME Associates (https://artheon.com/contact/).

Municipal work drags a per-client administrative trail: the Edgewater resolution shows the merger required a formal contract assignment with a Business Registration Certificate and Certificate of Insurance filed town by town (https://edgewaternj.org/DocumentCenter/View/12578/2026-150-Assignment-of-CME-to-Artheonpdf).

Public-sector contract work is appointment-based and renewed annually, e.g. the 2026 Township Engineer award to CME at up to $200/hour by resolution (https://www.eastbrunswick.org/DocumentCenter/View/10719/Notice-of-Professional-Services-for-the-Year-2026).
hiring_signals: 94 roles open on the company's own board, heavily weighted to field and document coordination rather than pure design (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).

Six Office Engineer openings (East Brunswick, Neptune, Camden, Berlin, New York, plus an NYCDEP/NYCDDC variant) whose duties are RFI, submittal, log, report and meeting-minutes tracking (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/f465fe26-bc79-416f-a1a4-8c288736f296).

Three Proposal Coordinator openings for RFP/RFQ review, compliance matrices, resume formatting and pursuit logs - classic repetitive bid-production work (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/14880147-d369-4c77-b261-3e27e0224e31).

Seven Resident Engineer and six Construction Inspector - Transportation postings plus Assistant Resident Engineer and Field Inspector roles, implying continuous jobsite coordination and daily reporting (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).
Two Estimator and one Construction Estimator openings in New York, plus a Grant Writing & Community Development Intern in Albany (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).
Director-level build-out: Director of MEP Engineering and Director of Structural Engineering both posted for East Brunswick (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).
Careers page itself carries no job listings and simply links out to the Trilon Pinpoint board (https://artheon.com/careers/).
review_themes: Google aggregate rating is 3.9 for the listing still named CME Associates; the limited Maps view exposes no review count and no review text, so themes cannot be read (https://www.google.com/maps/search/CME+Associates+1+Tower+Center+Blvd+East+Brunswick+NJ).

No customer testimonials, case-study quotes or review prompts appear on the site; project pages present photos and descriptions only, so there is no visible review-generation workflow (https://artheon.com/).
Contact-page credibility is undermined by placeholder content that is live on the page: five 'Lorem ipsum' sample posts, sample comments and a December 2025 archive (https://artheon.com/contact/).
tech_footprint: WordPress site with a cookie-consent/preferences banner, search box, and no chat, booking, quote or client-portal widget anywhere in the header or footer (https://artheon.com/contact/).
Structured data limited to WebPage/Organization on the contact page - no LocalBusiness markup, address, telephone, hours or service-area data (https://artheon.com/contact/).

Recruiting runs on Trilon's Pinpoint HQ board at trilongroup.pinpointhq.com, separate from the marketing site, with an internal-jobs landing page and a 'Register Your Interest' talent-pool link (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).
LinkedIn company page (artheon-inc) is the only social presence linked from the footer (https://artheon.com/).

Site construction/design credited to Splendor; page titles are plain brand titles (e.g. 'Contact - Artheon') with slogan-style meta descriptions rather than service or place terms (https://artheon.com/contact/).

Job postings name the tools the delivery teams actually use: Microsoft Excel/Word/Outlook, Bluebeam, Primavera P6 and Procore for construction administration, and Microsoft Office plus Adobe Creative Suite for proposals (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/f465fe26-bc79-416f-a1a4-8c288736f296).
growth_signals: Four-firm combination into Artheon in 2026 under Trilon Group ownership, with a stated platform ambition and investment in talent and growth (https://artheon.com/about/).
94 simultaneous openings across at least eight locations, from intern to director level, indicating rapid absorption of acquired teams (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).

Hiring in Albany, NY, which is not among the seven offices listed on the contact page - a sign of geographic expansion beyond the published footprint (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/art-internal-jobs).

Municipal contract positions being carried over and reassigned: East Brunswick's 2026 Township Engineer award and Edgewater's approval of the CME-to-Artheon contract assignment (https://www.eastbrunswick.org/DocumentCenter/View/10719/Notice-of-Professional-Services-for-the-Year-2026).
physical_signals: Head office address per municipal record and Google: 1 Tower Center Boulevard, 20th Floor, East Brunswick, NJ 08816 (https://edgewaternj.org/DocumentCenter/View/12578/2026-150-Assignment-of-CME-to-Artheonpdf).
Seven offices: Neptune, Camden, East Brunswick, Barnegat, NYC, Cape May Court House and Berlin (https://artheon.com/contact/).
Former CME address recorded in the same resolution: 3141 Bordentown Avenue, Parlin, NJ 08859 (https://edgewaternj.org/DocumentCenter/View/12578/2026-150-Assignment-of-CME-to-Artheonpdf).
Scale stated as more than 720 professionals across the combined firm (https://artheon.com/about/).

Operating profile is office plus jobsite work rather than a single fixed facility: postings are tied to project locations 'throughout New York City' and NJDOT/NJTA jobsites, plus survey crews, bridge inspectors and ACDI divers (https://trilongroup.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/f465fe26-bc79-416f-a1a4-8c288736f296).
decision_maker: Andy Paluri, PE, PTOE - Chief Executive Officer (https://artheon.com/leadership/); Laura Neumann, PE, PP - Vice President, Central Jersey, listed on the same page as the regional lead most likely covering East Brunswick

inferences.inference: Inquiries that arrive through search or AI answers are likely being lost, not just delayed.
inferences.reasoning: The Google profile still carries the old CME name and points its website field at cmeusa1.com, every legacy URL including the old contact page lands on the Artheon home page, and the home page has no link to a contact page and no form or email - so a visitor who wants to hire the firm has no clickable path except dialing a city number.

inferences.inference: A large share of staff time goes to per-client document production rather than engineering judgement.
inferences.reasoning: Six Office Engineer openings are defined around maintaining logs, tracking RFIs/submittals/shop drawings and writing weekly and monthly reports, and three Proposal Coordinator openings are defined around RFP compliance matrices, resume formatting and pursuit logs; that volume of near-identical paperwork is the classic case for drafting and tracking agents.

inferences.inference: The 2026 merger created a one-off but repeated clerical load across dozens of municipal clients.
inferences.reasoning: Edgewater's resolution shows the rebrand required a formal assignment agreement plus business registration certificate and certificate of insurance, approved town by town; the same package presumably had to be produced and tracked for each of the firm's many appointing authorities.

inferences.inference: The thin public review base understates or misrepresents the firm's actual client sentiment.
inferences.reasoning: The only public customer signal is a 3.9 aggregate on a profile still named for the predecessor company, with no review prompts anywhere on the new site and no testimonials; a firm with 720 staff and municipal appointments would normally accumulate far more feedback.

inferences.inference: Integration strain is visible in the content, not just the org chart.
inferences.reasoning: The contact page still serves lorem-ipsum sample posts and sample comments months after the 2026 relaunch, the portfolio mixes four legacy brands' logos, and the About timeline credits the combination to four firms while Trilon's own page names three - consistent with a fast, lightly-QA'd consolidation of four websites and brands.

data_gaps: Google review count and review text were not accessible: Maps served a limited view with no reviews panel, and a Google web search for reviews returned a bot-check page.
Indeed (HTTP 403) and Glassdoor were not readable, so employee-review ratings seen only in search snippets (Indeed 3.5, Glassdoor 4.1) are unverified and excluded from this profile.
No customer-facing review source (Yelp, BBB profile with rating, Trustpilot) could be opened for this firm; BBB directory presence was seen only as a search snippet.
No email address, contact form or street address for any office is published on artheon.com, so the only verified inbound channel is the seven listed phone numbers.
Business hours are published nowhere on the site; the only hours data is Google's 'Closed - Opens 9 AM Mon'.
Square footage, headcount by office and any fleet or equipment inventory are not stated by any source found.
An Albany, NY hiring presence appears in postings but is not listed as an office on the contact page; whether it is a physical office or remote hiring is unconfirmed.

The 'Environmental & Geotechnical Division' label for the East Brunswick office in the triage record could not be re-verified on the current site; cmeusa1.com now redirects to the Artheon home page, so that claim is dropped here.
